item.title: Jason Hehir On ‘SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of,’ Martin Scorsese’s Unreleased Reunion & Catherine O’Hara [Interview]
item.description: For anyone who grew up in Canada during the 1970s and ’80s, “ SCTV ” was practically a religion, an absurdist, wonderfully irreverent comedy institution that helped shape an entire generation’s sense of humor. Now, 50 years after its debut, Netflix has finally given the series its due, making the original episodes available to stream alongside an affectionate, often hilarious, and unexpectedly moving documentary about its creation and enduring influence.
